flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.q: The DAO hack: date, size, mechanism?
flashcards.a: June 2016, 3.6M ETH (~$50-60M then): withdraw() made external call BEFORE deducting balances; attacker's fallback reentered repeatedly. Led to the chain fork (ETH/ETC split).

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.q: Two reentrancy fixes and their priority?
flashcards.a: 1) Checks-effects-interactions: finalize state before external calls - primary, covers cross-function cases. 2) nonReentrant mutex (OpenZeppelin) - belt-and-suspenders on critical paths.

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.a: Same-function loop; cross-function (shared unfinalized state); cross-contract via token hooks (ERC-777 tokensReceived, ERC-721 _safeMint callbacks); read-only reentrancy (view functions report inconsistent mid-tx state - Curve views).

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.a: July 30 2023: Vyper compiler 0.2.15/0.3.0 silently disabled @nonreentrant decorators; Curve pools drained ~$70M despite repeated audits. Lesson: toolchain regressions resurrect dead bug classes.

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.q: What did Solidity 0.8 change and what remains?
flashcards.a: Dec 2020: arithmetic overflow/underflow reverts by default (BatchOverflow BEC/SMT class extinct in new code). Remains: narrowing casts truncate silently, unchecked blocks, assembly, legacy deployed tokens.

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.a: ~$950k across two attacks using flash loans to pump Uniswap prices then borrow against them at inflated marks: introduced the oracle-manipulation era - attacks needing zero owned capital.

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.a: Chainlink-style feeds: deviation threshold ~0.5% + heartbeat staleness checks + L2 sequencer uptime feeds; Uniswap V3 TWAP >=30 min; per-block exposure caps; circuit breakers. Never settle against your own pool's spot price.

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.a: One manipulated block (12s) inside a 30-min window shifts arithmetic TWAP by ~(12/1800)x(99) = +66% for a 100x spike; 60s gives +330%. TWAP raises attack cost (sustained capital deployment), doesn't eliminate manipulation.

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.a: Front-run buy -> victim swap at worse price -> back-run sell = victim slippage extracted risk-free-ish. Real stops: private order flow (Flashbots Protect/MEV Blocker), batch auctions with uniform clearing (CoW), commit-reveal for admin flows, MEV taxes.

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.a: April 17 2022: flash-loaned ~$1B, bought 67% governance weight within ONE block, voted treasury transfer to attacker, repaid loan - $182M net in seconds. Fix: temporal expense in governance (snapshots, multi-block voting).

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.q: Euler Finance case numbers and lesson?
flashcards.a: March 13 2023: $197M via donation/convertible sub-account economics after FOUR audit reports; nearly all funds returned through negotiated whitehat settlement. Lesson: audits miss compositional economics; response quality matters equally.

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.q: Why are flash loans amplifiers, not vulnerabilities?
flashcards.a: Atomic borrow-repay-or-revert within one tx drops capital barriers from millions to fees: weaponizes manipulable oracles, instant-finality governance, mispriced collateral. Design must assume free temporary capital.

flashcards.topic: Reentrancy, Overflow, Oracle Manipulation, Front-Running, Audits
flashcards.q: Current loss-frequency ranking of these bug classes (2025-26)?
flashcards.a: 1) Oracle/economic manipulation 2) access control/key compromise 3) MEV extraction (chronic tax) 4) reentrancy (rare solo; tooling failures) 5) overflow (near-extinct in new code). Budget defenses by current threat data.
